SELECT sc.conversation_id AS id, sc.conversation_id AS conversationId, MAX(sc.user_id) AS userId, MAX(sc.problem_id) AS problemId, MAX(sc.set_id) AS setId, MAX(sc.is_set) AS isSet, COUNT(*) AS messageCount, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN sc.message_role = 'USER' AND sc.message_content IS NOT NULL AND sc.message_content != '' THEN LEFT(sc.message_content, 200) END ORDER BY sc.create_time ASC SEPARATOR '<|>' ), '<|>', 1 ) AS preview, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(sc.message_type ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1 ) AS lastMessageType, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN sc.status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'ERROR' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END AS status, COALESCE(SUM(sc.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(sc.streaming_duration), 0) AS totalDurationMs, MIN(sc.create_time) AS startedAt, MAX(sc.create_time) AS lastActiveAt FROM sys_conversation sc
GROUP BY sc.conversation_id ORDER BY lastActiveAt DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT sc.conversation_id FROM sys_conversation sc
GROUP BY sc.conversation_id ) session_cnt
